description: This file defines the CursoService class, which provides core business logic for managing 'Curso' entities in the application, including creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving courses.

classes.name: CursoService
classes.description: Service class responsible for business logic related to 'Curso' entities, including creation, update, deletion, and retrieval.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Curso entity based on the provided CursoDto, after verifying that a course with the same name does not already exist.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Curso entity identified by id_curso with data from the provided Curso object.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the given Curso entity from the repository.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Curso entities.
